cpu.boundary: AXI4 I-read + AXI4 D-read/write + AXI-Lite CSR/interrupt sideband
cpu.region_policy: reserved region after parent-context seed placement
cpu.signoff: CPU internal paths and CPU-to-fabric boundary paths

ai.boundary: AXI4-Lite CSR slave + AXI4 256-bit data master + IRQ
ai.region_policy: reserved compute region; no DDR PHY resources
ai.signoff: INT8 MAC pipeline and AXI master timing

dma.boundary: AXI4-Lite CSR slave + AXI4 256-bit data master + pixel stream + IRQ
dma.signoff: burst master, camera stream and interrupt paths

axi_fabric.boundary: four AXI4 masters to one AXI4 memory master
axi_fabric.region_policy: interface corridor between compute modules and HMIC CDC
axi_fabric.signoff: arbitration, QoS, burst ordering and boundary timing

ddr.boundary: PDS HMIC AXI user port + DDR3 pins
ddr.region_policy: official HMIC placement and constraints are authoritative
ddr.signoff: HMIC training, DDR timing and official CA/DQS/clock topology
